description: The bar chart titled “Evaluation Based on Different Tasks” illustrates accuracy values for two evaluation tasks, with multiple model conditions shown per task. The horizontal axis contains the task categories “MCQ Eval” and “Generation Eval,” arranged left to right, and the vertical axis is labeled “Accuracy” on a linear scale spanning roughly 0.0 to 0.7 with evenly spaced tick marks at about 0.2 intervals. For “MCQ Eval,” three adjacent bars are shown: an orange bar labeled “Base” with a value annotated as 0.644, a light green bar with an annotated value of 0.539, and a pale yellow bar labeled “RMU” with an annotated value of 0.299. For “Generation Eval,” three adjacent bars are similarly arranged: an orange “Base” bar annotated as 0.597, a light green bar annotated as 0.263, and a pale yellow “RMU” bar annotated as 0.106. A legend centered below the plot maps colors to conditions, showing orange for “Base,” pale yellow for “RMU,” and a light green entry (label not clearly readable), along with an additional gray legend swatch without a clearly readable label; the bars are not shown as stacked, and there is no visual indication that categories are sorted beyond the left-to-right task order or that any bars are specially emphasized beyond the numeric value labels above each bar.
